notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Patch notes for v1.0.5.

[list]
[*] Added footstep sound to Wooden Castle’s bridge.
[*] Fixed missing fence in Raven Rock.
[*] Fixed poorly placed Cave-entrance shadows.
[*] Fixed poorly placed Cave-entrance lights.
[*] Fixed a few misspellings.
[*] Locked OSTs will show up as “???” instead of “Locked Soundtrack”.
[*] Pressing “Enter” will also serve as interact.
[*] Fixed prompt display delay.
[*] Footstep Sound was missing from one of the caves.
[*] Fixed minor issue with save-location in two zones.
[*] Removed some of the stone-piles and skulls in the Forgotten Crag area.
[*] Optimized the room with too many flame-canons in Bleak Rock.
[*] Corrected text display bugs in the OST player. 
[*] Fixed an issue where one of the soundtracks was playing incorrectly.  
[*] Optimized the game, some regions was causing frame rate drops.
[*] Fixed missing and miss-placed tiles in multiple places.
[/list]
